note: Ninety days (2160 one-hour steps) of the measured Reservoirs model, imported through /api/models/reservoirs/live/import from the seeded simulation (sdlab/examples/reservoirs/machines/sim.py, seed 20261016). levels: the 6 measured stocks in ML (rain in the last hour, soil moisture, upper, middle and lower reservoirs, water tower), to 0.1 ML. rates is empty: the model has no flows. counters is NOT page-visible data: the simulator's per-hour amount of every true flow (ML, to 0.001), including the rivers nobody measures, for checking discovery against the truth. Ground truth: sdlab/examples/reservoirs/truth.json.
